references.text: Here God describes what Israel has done—they have sinned and taken some of the devoted things. Achan's confession in verse 20 confirms this accusation.
The intercession ritual where a person confesses their sin with the words 'I have sinned' follows the same pattern as Achan's confession.
Saul uses a similar confession formula when he says 'I have sinned' after breaking God's command.
David confesses his sin with the words 'I have sinned against the Lord'—the same wording that Achan uses.
David's confession of sin in Psalm 51 expresses the recognition of having sinned against God, just as Achan confesses.
Proverbs teaches that the one who confesses their sins will find mercy—Achan openly confesses what he has done.
The prodigal son's confession 'I have sinned against heaven and before you' reflects Achan's confession formula.
